Toddler Storytime

Wed, Dec 2 2026
11:15 am – 11:45 am
Park Slope Library

birth to five babies & books early literacy first five years storytime

Enjoy stories, songs, and rhymes for toddlers. This program is for little ones, 18 months to 3 years, and their caregivers. 

Advance registration is required. Registration opens 24 hours before the event. Only participants who have registered online will be admitted; there is no waitlist. 

Park Slope Library
431 6th Ave
Brooklyn, NY 11215 Get Directions
